messages.subject: Disappearing layer_lines with tooltip?
parts:
I am able to create a line chart with points and tooltips with the chart data as:

all_values <- function(x) {
    if(is.null(x)) return(NULL)
    paste0(names(x), ": ", format(x), collapse = "<br />")
}

ggvis(mdf, x=~month, y=~value, stroke=~cohort) %>% layer_lines() %>% layer_points(size = 1, fill = ~cohort) %>% add_tooltip(html=all_values, on='click')

However if I use the doc example to customize the tooltip with additional data as:

mdf$id <- 1:nrow(mdf) # Add an id column to use ask the key

all_values <- function(x) {
    if(is.null(x)) return(NULL)
    row <- mdf[mdf$id == x$id, ]
    paste0(names(row), ": ", format(row), collapse = "<br />")
}

ggvis(mdf, x=~month, y=~value, key := ~id, stroke=~cohort) %>% layer_lines() %>% layer_points(size = 1, fill = ~cohort) %>% add_tooltip(html=all_values, on='click')

upon rendering in RStudio the lines layer is briefly displayed, removed, leaving the vis with only the points but tooltip text as desired.

Is this an issue in ggvis 0.4, or an issue with the above approach?
